{{Quote|I am Mdel, the elder of this village.|Mdel|<ref name="PoK" />}}
'''Mdel''' was a [[Kadrillian/Legends|Kadrillian]] [[Nociv]] at the time of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] attempt to conquer [[Kadril]] in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]].

==Biography==
Mdel was an older [[Kadrillian/Legends|Kadrillian]] and the village's eldest of a [[Nociv]] village of which also [[Deerna]] was a member. [[Rodno]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], warned the Nocivs for an ongoing attack by [[stormtrooper]]s with [[Pacifog]]. [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] wanted to collect all [[Kunda]] on Kadril and these stocks were located in the Nociv area.

Despite the warning, Mdel died during the attack with the [[Pacifog]]. Already dying he advised the Nociv to fight against the Empire with Han and Luke. Mdel was ritually buried on the [[Hom Mounds]].
